title: stash / cherry-pick / tag 演示
expected_output:
stash / cherry-pick / tag 演示
  git stash 输出: Saved working directory and index state WIP on main: a2a34c2 base
  stash 后工作区干净(porcelain 空): True
  stash list: stash@{0}: WIP on main: a2a34c2 base
  stash pop 后改动恢复(porcelain 非空): True
  cherry-pick feat 后 HEAD: 47ce345 (在 main 上重现了该提交)
  轻量标签 v1 -> cat-file -t: commit (指向 a2a34c2)
  附注标签 v2 -> cat-file -t: tag (独立 tag 对象)
结论: stash 暂存半成品；cherry-pick 摘取单个提交；轻量 tag 仅引用 commit，附注 tag 是有 SHA 的独立对象
code:
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, pathlib

GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ)
for _k, _v in [("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")]:
    GIT_ENV[_k] = _v

def g(args, cwd):
    r = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed:\n%s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout

def new_repo():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repo_")
    g(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], d)
    g(["config", "user.name", "dev"], d)
    g(["config", "user.email", "dev@example.com"], d)
    g(["config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.autocrlf", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.eol", "lf"], d)
    return d

def w(d, name, content):
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / name
    if isinstance(content, str):
        p.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    else:
        p.write_bytes(content)

def blob_sha(content_bytes):
    b = content_bytes.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content_bytes, str) else content_bytes
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    h.update(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\x00" + b)
    return h.hexdigest()


d = new_repo()
w(d, "a.txt", "v1\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "base"], d)
base = g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()
w(d, "a.txt", "v1-modified\n")
stash_out = g(["stash"], d).strip()
after_stash = g(["status", "--porcelain"], d).strip()
stash_list = g(["stash", "list"], d).strip()
g(["stash", "pop"], d)
after_pop = g(["status", "--porcelain"], d).strip()
g(["branch", "feature"], d)
g(["checkout", "-q", "feature"], d)
w(d, "f.txt", "feature only\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "feat"], d)
feat = g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()
g(["checkout", "-q", "main"], d)
g(["cherry-pick", feat], d)
cp = g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()
g(["tag", "v1", base], d)
g(["tag", "-a", "v2", "-m", "annotated", base], d)
v1_type = g(["cat-file", "-t", "v1"], d).strip()
v2_type = g(["cat-file", "-t", "v2"], d).strip()
v1_target = g(["rev-parse", "v1"], d).strip()
print("stash / cherry-pick / tag 演示")
print("  git stash 输出: " + stash_out)
print("  stash 后工作区干净(porcelain 空): " + str(after_stash == ""))
print("  stash list: " + stash_list)
print("  stash pop 后改动恢复(porcelain 非空): " + str(after_pop != ""))
print("  cherry-pick feat 后 HEAD: " + cp[:7] + " (在 main 上重现了该提交)")
print("  轻量标签 v1 -> cat-file -t: " + v1_type + " (指向 " + v1_target[:7] + ")")
print("  附注标签 v2 -> cat-file -t: " + v2_type + " (独立 tag 对象)")
print("结论: stash 暂存半成品；cherry-pick 摘取单个提交；轻量 tag 仅引用 commit，附注 tag 是有 SHA 的独立对象")
